turns.final: Plan submitted: retries belong in the queue; keep `charge()` as a single-attempt operation.

calls.result: {"decision":"queue","plan":"Keep `charge()` as a single-attempt client operation; do not add retry logic to `HttpClient` or this function, since the shared client also serves the batch path. Add retries around queued charge execution, defining retryable failures and a bounded attempt/backoff policy there. Test queue retry/exhaustion behavior, stubbing `HttpClient`; keep `BASE` unchanged."}
